name: eclipticam
max_jpg_notes: max.jpg presentation only. Peter picked the loosened stretch ALONE here (2026-08-26) — no area_gain, no sky_frac: on eclipticam the light dome reads as sky rather than as pollution, and flattening it made the picture worse. Opposite call to astrocam, which is why these are per-camera knobs.
frames_root_notes: Single source of truth (CameraConfig.frames_root), resolved PER-HOST. Default (~/eclipticam-frames) is the capture host's view (muppet's bigstore export NFS-automounted there); pip reaches the same export at /mnt/muppet/bigstore/eclipticam-frames (pip's ~ symlink removed 2026-08-02). Add a host key to teach a new machine.
night_layout_notes: day/YYYY-MM-DD/<cam>/HH/NNNN.jpg (UTC date); night/YYYY-MM-DD/<cam>/HH/NNNN.fits.fz (noon-rollover night date). HHb/ siblings hold 2x2 sum-binned frames.

v1.pedestal_notes: CHART FLOOR ONLY, on the v1 CONTAINER basis: these frames are 10-frame coadds, uint32, and still MSB-aligned (deliberately NOT repacked — shifting them would move the whole basis). So this number lives on a 10 x 64 x per-frame scale and is NOT comparable to the v3w pedestal. 10180 / 10 coadds / 64 (MSB) = 15.9 per frame, which is the OV5647 black level — see black_level.
v1.black_level_notes: OV5647 electronic zero, PER FRAME in 10-bit LSB-aligned ADU. Two independent measurements agree: this camera's 10180 / 10 coadds / 64 = 15.9, and starcam's 4x coadd floor 61.184 / 4 = 15.30. Call it ~15-16, the usual OV5647 black level. NOTE this is ~16, NOT 64: a 2026-08-20 session concluded 'the v1 OV5647 pedestal is exactly 64' from a mode labelled ov5647_v3w_coexist, but that label is a DATE RANGE and those frames are IMX708 v3w. There are no eclipticam OV5647 frames in the quality DB at all.
v1.blackest_observed_notes: Unknown — no eclipticam v1 frames were ever ingested into the quality DB (build_db.py assigns modes by date, and every eclipticam path it walks is v3w). Scan the v1 tree to fill this in.
v1.plate_scale_notes: OV5647 stock lens, 53.50 deg horizontal / 2592 px (official RPi figure).
v1.max_single_exposure_notes: picamera2 video-config ceiling ~3.07 s; longer integrations must use the streaming coadd path.

v3w.pedestal_notes: CHART FLOOR ONLY — log2(mean/pedestal) axis reference, chosen for footroom, not a measurement. See black_level and blackest_observed. Matches astrocam so both charts share an axis.
v3w.black_level_notes: IMX708 electronic zero, 10-bit LSB-aligned ADU. INFERRED (nominal 64, consistent with the 64.82 earliest-v3w floor which is an upper bound); not measured from dark frames. See eclipticam-v3w/camera.json.
v3w.blackest_observed_notes: Darkest frame mean recorded, 2026-08-20, n=18834. Footroom above black_level ~7.3 ADU. Min-of-N estimator; refresh from the quality DB.
v3w.plate_scale_notes: Module 3 Wide, 102 deg horizontal / 2304 px at the half-res capture mode in use (native 4608x2592).

rotate_180_notes: Camera sensor is physically mounted upside down. In-capture 180° rotation is applied so stored frames are right-side up. No downstream rotation in processing.
